title: Stomach Pain, Acidity, Gastritis & Gas — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
source: CDSCO Allopathic Standards & AYUSH Charaka Samhita
content:
Condition: Acidity, GERD, Gastritis, Indigestion (Amlapitta / Agnimandya), Bloating & Gas.
Allopathic Pharmacology: Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPI): Pantoprazole 40mg or Omeprazole 20mg once daily 30 minutes before breakfast. Antacids: Aluminium Hydroxide + Magnesium Hydroxide + Simethicone syrup (10ml post meals). For spasms: Dicyclomine 10-20mg.
Ayurvedic Formulations: Avipattikar Churna (3-5g with cool water before meals) for hyperacidity and heartburn. Hingwashtak Churna (1-2g with first morsel of food and ghee) for gas and bloating. Shankha Bhasma (250mg with lemon water).
Home Remedies: Jeera-Dhaniya-Saunf (CCF) tea (Cumin, Coriander, Fennel seeds boiled in water), Cold milk (1/2 cup for acute acid flare), Fresh Buttermilk (Takra) with roasted cumin and mint, Amla juice (20ml morning).
Precautions: Do not lie down immediately after eating. If severe sharp right lower abdominal pain (possible appendicitis) or black stools occur, seek emergency care.
